title: RecipeHub - Recipe Sharing Platform
description: A full-stack recipe sharing platform where users can discover, create, like, and manage recipes, while administrators can monitor content, users, and platform activities through a secure dashboard.
features: Role-based authentication for Users and Admins
Create, edit, delete, and manage personal recipes
Browse, search, and filter recipes by category
Like and add recipes to Favorites
Premium membership with Stripe payment integration
Responsive User Dashboard for recipe and profile management
Admin Dashboard to manage users, recipes, reports, and premium requests
Secure JWT authentication with protected routes

title: Job Portal Website
description: A full-stack job portal platform where job seekers can search and apply for jobs, while recruiters can post and manage job listings through a secure and responsive dashboard.
features: Role-based authentication for Job Seekers and Recruiters
Create, update, and manage job postings
Advanced job search and filtering system
Apply for jobs with application tracking
Responsive dashboard for recruiters and applicants
Secure JWT authentication and protected routes
